Fixed in the script (splitlines) for a future run; not rerun.
memory_method: peak_vmhwm_kib = max per-process VmHWM over the engine process tree, polled every 10 ms; ru_maxrss_kib = os.wait4 (floored at parent_rss_floor_kib by exec semantics)

post_capture_changes.change: registry metadata/source-archive HTTP (registry.rs) no longer sets a request-level reqwest .timeout(30s) (a whole-transfer deadline in reqwest 0.12.28, TotalTimeoutBody); the client uses Bazel HttpConnector timeouts shared with the repository transport: 10 s connect, 20 s per send/read (blocking ClientBuilder.timeout), no total deadline. Audit: the only reqwest clients are registry.rs and extension_download.rs; neither sets a request-level timeout now.
post_capture_changes.test: registry::tests::source_downloads_have_a_per_read_timeout_but_no_total_deadline (1 s per-read client: ~3 s dribbled body succeeds, a 1.6 s gap fails)

repository_ctx.download with a checksum reuses an existing output whose digest matches without downloading, also with downloads disabled (DownloadManager.java:247-261; disable check at java:331)
tar type '7' (contiguous) entries extract as regular files
